Hi Sanjay / Maya —

Welcome — glad to see Acadian Labs progressing through vendor intake. To complete creation of your billing record and enable POs, could you confirm the following items and attach the supporting docs where available? I’ve listed the minimum AP fields we need to push this live.

Required company information (please reply inline):
- Official legal name (as registered):
- Registered entity type (LLC / C-Corp / Ltd / etc.):
- Registered address (line 1 / city / state / postal / country):
- Tax identifier (EIN / VAT or local equivalent):
- Primary invoice email / PO routing address (where Redwood should send POs):
- Primary billing contact (name / role / email / phone):
- Remittance preference (ACH / wire / check) and bank details for ACH (if ACH): account name, routing, account number
- W-9 (US) or equivalent tax form (attach)

Optional but helpful: preferred invoice terms (Net 30 / Net 45), currency if different from USD, and a billing PO prefix you’d like Redwood to include to help your AP match invoices.

We also require a named signatory who can approve onboarding paperwork; if you’d like we can send a DocuSign packet for an authorized representative.

Attachments you can send as separate files (PDF / XLSX): W-9, bank detail spreadsheet, signatory authorization.

Timeline: once we receive the required items, AP typically finishes setup within 3 business days and we’ll confirm the vendor ID and PO channel.

Thanks — ping me if you want to hop on a 15-min call to speed this up.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

- Confirm ACH has both account number and routing (no masked copies)
- Request bank letter if account name differs from legal name (I’ve seen this with some corporate accounts)
- Make sure the W-9 name matches the legal name exactly; otherwise mark for legal review
- Set PO prefix ACAD- in our PO template routing config

Karthik: can you confirm whether Procurement needs a secondary contact for trial POs? If so, we should capture a secondary AP email.
